rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for informal or nonstandard vocabulary, especially in explanations or writing.

example.english: When writing, it is best to explain the meaning of this slang.
example.traditional: 寫文章嗰陣，最好解釋清楚呢個俚語嘅意思。
example.jyutping: se2 man4 zoeng1 go2 zan6 zeoi3 hou2 gaai2 sik1 cing1 co2 ni1 go3 lei5 jyu5 ge3 ji3 si1

rows.note: Use this specifically for jargon used within a profession, trade, or specialist field.

example.english: After working on construction sites for a while, you naturally understand a lot of trade slang.
example.traditional: 做地盤耐咗，就自然聽得明好多行話。
example.jyutping: zou6 dei6 pun4 noi6 zo2 zau6 zi6 jin4 teng1 dak1 ming4 hou2 do1 hong4 waa2

rows.note: Use this for secretive group speech, especially language intended to keep outsiders from understanding.

example.english: They use secret slang when they talk, so outsiders cannot understand at all.
example.traditional: 佢哋用黑話傾偈，搞到外人完全聽唔明。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 hak1 waa2 king1 gai2 gaau2 dou3 ngoi6 jan4 jyun4 cyun4 teng1 m4 ming4
